description: Classic-first public regression drills using only features available in the ordinary Rugby Studio editor. Minion Mode is a visual translation of the same frames and action data.

drills.title: Test 01 · Tackle → ground → present → recover
drills.objective: See the runner fall, lie flat, present the separately rendered ball backwards, then regain feet.
drills.safety: VISUAL SOFTWARE QA ONLY — not a practical session plan. Freeze and inspect the animation. For any real contact training, follow the current RFU age-grade rules and use appropriately qualified supervision; never infer safe tackle technique from a sprite.

frames.name: 1 · Carrier upright; defender ready
frames.notes: A1 upright with the ball, D1 visibly ready; A2 waits deeper.

frames.name: 2 · Approach tackle
frames.notes: A1 moves towards D1. D1 closes the gap and tracks the carrier.

frames.name: 3 · Tackle impact / falling
frames.notes: Watch the impact transition: A1 must visibly fall, never slide upright.

frames.name: 4 · Clearly flat on the ground
frames.notes: Freeze. A1 must unmistakably be lying on the ground, not crouching.

frames.name: 5 · Ball presented backwards
frames.notes: A1 stays grounded; ball is released towards support at larger Y, not shot metres away.

frames.name: 6 · A2 approaches; A1 recovers
frames.notes: Ball is still on the ground; A1 is clearly getting up. No sliding across the turf.

drills.players: A1 carrying, D1 tackling, A2 supporting
drills.equipment: Digital rugby objects only; no physical equipment required for this visual QA.
drills.instructions: 1. Open the drill in Classic view. 2. Play and scrub each named step. 3. Toggle Minion Mode without modifying steps. 4. Confirm positions, timing, possession, poses and contact meaning stay the same.
drills.coaching: Visual verification only. No alternative rugby behaviour is permitted in Minion Mode.
drills.regression: Test one isolated step at a time with playback paused, then compare with Classic at the identical timestamp.
drills.progression: Play the complete sequence and export a Minion Mode video; verify the same pose at each timestamp and the same movement on the pitch.
drills.questions: Can a viewer identify the action without reading the label? Is the Minion correctly oriented? Is ball/contact/equipment independent? Does it animate without sudden teleporting?
drills.notes: Classic view is the reference. Use the same drill at the same step/time and then switch to Minion Mode. This is software QA, not training advice.

branching.question: Does A1 carry forwards or pass backwards to A2?
branching.context: Inspect where A1 looks before acting. Both options start from identical positions.
branching.watchFor: Direction of the ball and the defender response.

choices.label: Carry — D1 closes for touch

frames.name: A · Carry into the space
frames.notes: OPTION A: A1 carries. D1 tracks and closes with touch only; A2 does not receive the ball.

choices.explanation: A1 keeps the ball and carries into space. D1 tracks for touch, not a physical tackle.
choices.watchFor: Gaze, running stance and no teleport.

choices.label: Pass back — A2 catches

frames.name: B · Pass backwards to A2
frames.notes: OPTION B: A1 passes BACKWARDS to A2; D1 follows the new carrier.

choices.explanation: A1 looks at A2 then passes backwards, with A2 still behind A1.
choices.watchFor: Early gaze, ball direction, receiving hands and rewind.
